# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Pidgeon frequently twirls his mustache and casts romantic glances toward older female students. He was once seen crying during his farewell address, showing tears in his eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Personality

He exhibits a strict, sarcastic, and sometimes overbearing approach to discipline, often resorting to punishments that humiliate his students or incite their anger. He tends to focus his attention disproportionately on older pupils while neglecting younger ones, and he shows a penchant for romance and dramatic sentimentality.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Goals

- court Sukey Pullen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, where he frequently focused his attention on preparing older pupils like Sukey Pullen for higher examinations while courting Sukey continuously. During his tenure, he clashed with Nell Harcourt when he punished her by forcing her to stand on the dais and later assigning her to sit next to Hugh Carrow, prompting Nell to temporarily boycott school. He frequently used physical discipline and strict punishments, leading to confrontations with parents such as Sam Gammon's father. Despite criticisms of his teaching efficacy and lax classroom control, some community members like Obed Abernethy noted that he spoke highly of dedicated students. At a local concert, he delivered an impassioned recital of Mark Antony's address. At the end of June, his term at Brierley came to an end, and he gave a tearful farewell address to his students before being succeeded by Miss Thorne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- lodged at the home of Eben Duckett during his teaching tenure in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- secured his teaching position due to his uncle's control as a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
